caption: The drawing features a clear glass tumbler depicted in pencil on a plain, off-white background. The tumbler has a slightly conical shape, wider at the top and narrower at the bottom. The surface of the glass is decorated with a pattern: the upper portion has a band featuring diamond shapes with cross-hatch shading, bordered by thin horizontal lines and teardrop or oval motifs. Below this band, the main body of the glass is adorned with evenly spaced vertical flutes or grooves that extend almost to the base of the tumbler. The rim and the bottom edge of the glass are both indicated with a fine line, with the base encircled by a narrow decorative border. The entire tumbler is centered within a rectangular frame drawn on the sheet, and there is shading to suggest the transparency and texture of the glass. There are no other objects or color variations present; the drawing relies on pencil shading to depict the form and details.
title: Flip
